name: Ukawa Chihiro
source:
A handler at SORD’s Keihin Sakuragaoka campus, Ukawa is responsible for instructing [url=/c59696]Vanilla[/url] and [url=/c59697]Choco[/url].

"You two - put a stop to it right now."
